text:
alex_support: bumping this — customer reports function call failing after a recent tool rename. API returns 400 {"error":"tool_not_found","tool_key":"send-email"}. They used tool key send-email previously; we've renamed to SendEmail. Happening on hosted and private customers. Repro steps:
1) call /v1/call with {"tool":"send-email","args":{...}}
2) response 400
Request payload and response attached.

maria_engineer: can you paste the exact request headers and the tool list from registry? also which region and runtime version?

alex_support: headers: Authorization, x-customer-id: acme-42, x-runtime-version: 2026-02-11, x-registry-version: 84
Payload:
```json
{"tool":"send-email","args":{"to":"bob@acme.com"}}
```
Response:
```json
{"error":"tool_not_found","message":"no tool matches 'send-email'","code":404}
```

sam_runtime: quick check — runtime normalizes tool keys to lowercase on lookup in some code paths; if registry has alias 'SendEmail' it's not matching 'send-email'. Looking at logs: runtime tried to resolve tool uuid 4f8a1b but registry lookup returned null. Possible sync gap between control plane and agents.

jess_prod: @sam_runtime any chance this is from the alias migration we ran last night? we added hyphenated aliases to maintain backward compatibility.

sam_runtime: yes, I see an alias migration job but it failed on the 'send-email' batch due to rate limits. The registry has a partial alias entry: "sendemail" and "Send-Email" but not "send-email". So older clients calling lowercase-hyphen form fail.

alex_support: customer says they never changed client code — they expect old alias to keep working. Is there a mitigation we can ask them to apply? Or a quick server-side fix?

maria_engineer: immediate mitigation: add a fallback rule in control plane to resolve exact lowercase-hyphen to the canonical uuid. I can run a one-off reindex for that tenant. @ci-bot can you queue reindex job for tenant acme-42 and force alias reconciliation?

ci-bot: queued reindex job 2026-03-15-1022 for tenant acme-42. ETA ~2m. Will post status.

sam_runtime: also pushing a hotfix to runtime lookup to normalize hyphens and case before lookup; will go out in 10m to edge nodes. This should make runtime resilient to alias gaps.

alex_support: great — customer notified. any chance we can add a debug endpoint to check alias map for a tenant? their engineering team wants to audit.

maria_engineer: we already have /v1/internal/registry/aliases?tenant=acme-42 — but it's gated. I'll run and paste snippet.

maria_engineer: snippet:
```json
{"tool_uuid":"4f8a1b","aliases":["SendEmail","sendemail","Send-Email"]}
```

alex_support: missing 'send-email' confirmed. Thanks.

jess_prod: postmortem note: migration job should create exact legacy hyphenated lowercase aliases. Add test to migration harness.

sam_runtime: logging note: add metric registry.alias_mismatch and alert when lookup fails but control plane returns potential matches.

alex_support: closing loop — reindex job completed and runtime hotfix deployed. customer reports calls succeeded after ~7m. I'll tag as resolved and write a KB.

maria_engineer: KB draft: short guidance + mitigation commands. Recommend also adding automatic alias retention for 180 days.

alex_support: thanks all :thumbsup:
